articles.title: Mirror
articles.summary: Mirror mask horizontally (flip leftright). It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > centre > selection / mask bar under the canvas.

articles.title: Zoom
articles.summary: Zoom viewport to fit current zone's selection. It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > centre > selection / mask bar under the canvas.

controls.label: Zoom
controls.effect: Zoom viewport to fit current zone's selection

articles.title: Flip Placement H
articles.summary: flip the placement target (base/pattern/overlay) horizontally. It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > centre > placement bar (shows while placing a pattern / base by hand).

articles.title: Flip Placement V
articles.summary: flip the placement target (base/pattern/overlay) vertically. It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > centre > placement bar (shows while placing a pattern / base by hand).

articles.title: 90° (placement), clockwise
articles.summary: Rotate active placement target 90° clockwise. It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > centre > placement bar (shows while placing a pattern / base by hand).

articles.title: 90° (placement), counter-clockwise
articles.summary: Rotate active placement target 90° counter-clockwise. It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > centre > placement bar (shows while placing a pattern / base by hand). Rotate active placement target 90° clockwise.

articles.title: Reset (placement bar (shows while...)
articles.summary: Reset active placement target to centered defaults. It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > centre > placement bar (shows while placing a pattern / base by hand).

controls.label: Reset
controls.effect: Reset active placement target to centered defaults

articles.title: Done (placement bar (shows while...)
articles.summary: keep current values and exit placement mode (Esc also works). It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > centre > placement bar (shows while placing a pattern / base by hand).

controls.label: Done
controls.effect: keep current values and exit placement mode (Esc also works)

articles.title: 90° (transform), counter-clockwise
articles.summary: Rotate active transform 90 degrees counter-clockwise. It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > centre > transform bar (shows during Transform). Rotate active placement target 90° clockwise.

articles.title: 90° (transform), clockwise
articles.summary: Rotate active transform 90 degrees clockwise. It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > centre > transform bar (shows during Transform). Rotate active placement target 90° clockwise.

articles.title: 180 degrees (rotate transform)
articles.summary: Rotate active transform 180 degrees. It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > centre > transform bar (shows during Transform).

articles.title: Apply (transform bar (shows during...)
articles.summary: Apply active transform. It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > centre > transform bar (shows during Transform).

articles.title: Choose zone to assign picked color
articles.summary: Choose which zone to add this color to. It is a drop-down menu.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > centre > Color (eyedropper) tool bar.
how: Open the menu and pick a choice.

controls.label: Choose zone to assign picked color
controls.effect: Choose which zone to add this color to

aliases: choose zone to assign picked color

articles.title: Add Color
articles.summary: Add Color: adds the clicked colour to the chosen zone. It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > centre > Color (eyedropper) tool bar.
when: Select several colours in one zone.

controls.label: Add Color
controls.effect: + Add Color: adds the clicked colour to the chosen zone

combos.why: Works together with the PICK COLOR FROM CAR control.

articles.title: Exclude (Color (eyedropper) tool...)
articles.summary: paint areas on the car to REMOVE from this zone's color match (red overlay). It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > centre > Color (eyedropper) tool bar.

controls.label: Exclude
controls.effect: paint areas on the car to REMOVE from this zone's color match (red overlay)

articles.title: Set (Color (eyedropper) tool bar)
articles.summary: Set: replaces the zone's colour with this single colour. It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > centre > Color (eyedropper) tool bar. Replace zone's color with this single color.

controls.label: Set
controls.effect: Set: replaces the zone's colour with this single colour

combos.why: Works together with the + Add Color control.

articles.title: Use Region
articles.summary: Use Region: gives the current selection (rect / lasso / brush) to the zone selected on the left. It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > centre > Color (eyedropper) tool bar. Apply the current selection (rect/lasso/brush) to the zone selected on the left - no color needed.
when: Select by shape instead of colour.

controls.label: Use Region
controls.effect: Use Region: gives the current selection (rect / lasso / brush) to the zone...

combos.why: Works together with the Lasso control.
